chunks: And Dāwūd ibn al-Ḥuṣayn narrated from Abū al-ʿAbbās, from Abū ʿAbdillāh عليه السلام, who said:
I asked him about a man who guarantees another man's person until a specified term, such that if he does not bring him, then such-and-such dirhams are upon him.

He عليه السلام said: If he brings him by the appointed term, then what he mentioned is not upon him, and he remains guarantor of his person forever unless he begins with the dirhams. So if he begins with the dirhams, then he is liable for them if he does not bring him by the term that he set.

key_terms.أَجَّلَهُ: set or fixed as a deadline
key_terms.إِلَى أَجَلٍ: until a specified term or deadline
key_terms.بِالدَّرَاهِمِ: with the dirhams, meaning the monetary undertaking
key_terms.بِنَفْسِ الرَّجُلِ: for the person's presence or body
key_terms.دِرْهَمًا: a sum of dirhams as financial payment
key_terms.ضَامِنٌ: financially liable or bound to pay
key_terms.كَفِيلٌ: a guarantor responsible for producing the person
key_terms.يَتَكَفَّلُ: takes responsibility or gives a guarantee

ai.seo_question: When does a guarantor become financially liable if he promises to bring someone by a set time?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling about personal guarantee and financial liability tied to bringing a person by a specified deadline. It distinguishes between guaranteeing the person's presence and explicitly undertaking payment in dirhams, clarifying when monetary liability becomes binding.

en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: Hadith.3403 - It is narrated from Dawud ibn al-Husayn, from Abu al-Abbas, from Abu Abdullah (as):
I asked him about a man who guarantees (takes responsibility for) another man's presence until a specified time, and if he does not bring him, he will owe such-and-such amount of dirhams.

Imam (as) said: "If he brings him by the specified time, then he is not liable for what he mentioned, and he remains a guarantor for his presence indefinitely unless he begins with the dirhams. If he begins with the dirhams, then he is liable for them if he does not bring him by the specified time he had set."
